import diagram_membership as m
import eval_env as env
import support_expect as ex

# test "computeSubBlockAttachments keeps a power producer out of a consuming section"
public func test_computesubblockattachments_keeps_a_power_producer_out_of_a_consuming_section(out: Stream) -> bool:
    # The LDO consumes the buck's shared power rail; USB consumes an independent
    # signal from the USB module. Adoption must follow signal, never shared rail.
    mut ldo_port = env.section_port_default(b"V_RF_3P3")
    ldo_port.direction = env.PortDirection.in_
    ldo_port.signal_type = env.SignalType.power
    ldo_port.voltage = Some(3.3)
    mut usb_port = env.section_port_default(b"USB_DP")
    usb_port.signal_type = env.SignalType.differential
    mut ldo_section = env.section_default(b"TPS7A2018 1.8 V LDO")
    ldo_section.ports = [ldo_port]
    mut usb_section = env.section_default(b"USB")
    usb_section.ports = [usb_port]
    mut block = env.design_block_default(b"board-b-analog")
    block.sections = [ldo_section, usb_section]
    block.sub_blocks = [env.SubBlock(name=b"buck33", block=env.design_block_default(b"tps63806-rail"), source=b""), env.SubBlock(name=b"usb", block=env.design_block_default(b"usb-c-hs"), source=b"")]
    block.net_ties = [env.NetTie(a=b"buck33/VOUT", b=b"V_RF_3P3"), env.NetTie(a=b"usb/DP", b=b"USB_DP")]
    mut attachments = m.compute_sub_block_attachments(block)
    if not ex.ok(out, "power producer unattached", attachments[0].is_none()):
        return False
    mut attached = attachments[1]
    if attached is None:
        return ex.ok(out, "USB attached", False)
    return ex.eq_int(out, "USB section", attached, 1)


# test "attachedSubBlocks reports a section's own modules in declaration order"
public func test_attachedsubblocks_reports_a_section_s_own_modules_in_declaration_order(out: Stream) -> bool:
    mut block = env.design_block_default(b"board")
    block.sub_blocks = [env.SubBlock(name=b"one", block=env.design_block_default(b"mod-a"), source=b""), env.SubBlock(name=b"two", block=env.design_block_default(b"mod-b"), source=b""), env.SubBlock(name=b"three", block=env.design_block_default(b"mod-c"), source=b"")]
    mut attachments: int?[] = [Some(0), Some(1), Some(0)]
    mut owned = m.attached_sub_blocks(block, attachments, 0)
    mut expected: int[] = [0, 2]
    if not ex.ok(out, "declaration order", owned == expected):
        return False
    mut none = m.attached_sub_blocks(block, attachments, 7)
    return ex.eq_int(out, "empty section", len(none), 0)

# Guest tests translated from the `test "..."` blocks of zig/src/escape.zig.
# `std.Io.Writer.Allocating` is a `byte_builder.Builder` here.
import byte_builder
import escape

func every_byte() -> bytes:
    return bytes([for i in range(256) yield i])


# test "writeXml escapes markup and both quote styles"
public func test_writexml_escapes_markup_and_both_quote_styles() -> bool:
    mut out = byte_builder.create()
    escape.write_xml(mut out, b"a<b>&\"'c")
    assert byte_builder.finish(out) == b"a<b>&"'c", "escaped text"
    return True


# test "writeXml neutralizes a script/attribute breakout"
public func test_writexml_neutralizes_a_script_attribute_breakout() -> bool:
    mut out = byte_builder.create()
    escape.write_xml(mut out, b"\"><script>alert(1)</script>")
    mut written = byte_builder.finish(out)
    # No literal '<', '>' or '"' survives, so neither an attribute nor a tag can be closed.
    assert written.find(b"<") < 0, "no <"
    assert written.find(b">") < 0, "no >"
    assert written.find(b"\"") < 0, "no quote"
    return True


# test "the two apostrophe spellings differ in nothing but the apostrophe"
public func test_the_two_apostrophe_spellings_differ_in_nothing_but_the_apostrophe() -> bool:
    mut all_bytes = every_byte()
    mut decimal_out = byte_builder.create()
    mut hex_out = byte_builder.create()
    escape.write_xml(mut decimal_out, all_bytes)
    escape.write_xml_hex_apos(mut hex_out, all_bytes)
    mut decimal = byte_builder.finish(decimal_out)
    mut hexed = byte_builder.finish(hex_out)
    mut at = decimal.find(b"'")
    assert at >= 0, "decimal apostrophe present"
    assert decimal[0:at] == hexed[0:at], "prefix identical"
    assert decimal[at:at + 5] == b"'", "decimal spelling"
    assert hexed[at:at + 6] == b"'", "hex spelling"
    assert decimal[at + 5:len(decimal)] == hexed[at + 6:len(hexed)], "suffix identical"
    return True


# test "decodeXmlAlloc round-trips every byte writeXml can escape"
public func test_decodexmlalloc_round_trips_every_byte_writexml_can_escape() -> bool:
    mut all_bytes = every_byte()
    mut out = byte_builder.create()
    escape.write_xml(mut out, all_bytes)
    mut back = escape.decode_xml_alloc(byte_builder.finish(out))
    assert back == all_bytes, "round trip"
    return True


# test "decodeXmlAlloc copies an entity it does not know through verbatim"
public func test_decodexmlalloc_copies_an_entity_it_does_not_know_through_verbatim() -> bool:
    mut got = escape.decode_xml_alloc(b"a   b & c &")
    assert got == b"a   b & c &", "unknown entity passes through"
    return True

import sexpr_ast as ast
import pad_neck_profile
import numeric
import math
import support_crc32 as crc32
import support_strs as strs

# Core data vocabulary of the evaluated design. Strings that come from a model
# stay bytes; only lookup keys are decoded once to str.
public enum Value:
    number(value: float)
    string(value: bytes)
    boolean(value: bool)
    component(value: bytes)
    component_instance(value: ValueComponentInstance)
    block_def(value: BlockDef)
    design_block(value: DesignBlock)
    nil


public record ValueComponentInstance:
    family: bytes
    value: bytes
    attrs: bytes[]
    typed_attrs: Property[]


# A module definition retains its import scope after loading. Defaults are
# parallel to params: None marks required arguments, otherwise the stored AST
# is evaluated only when the caller omits that argument. source_file is restored
# when the body is evaluated so diagnostics name the defining module, not its
# caller; empty means a definition read from a buffer without a path.
public record BlockDef:
    name: bytes
    params: bytes[]
    defaults: ast.Node?[]
    body: ast.Node[]
    imports: Env
    source_file: bytes


# A pin reference in a net. asserted_fns are the alternate functions explicitly
# asserted by (as "FN1" "FN2" ...), including simultaneous firmware roles.
# i_typ/i_max are amperes from the pin form, attached to only the first physical
# pin of a group so sums count each instance once. load_label names the actual
# budget consumer when the annotation rides on a cap/bead; empty falls back to
# the instance component.
public record PinRef:
    ref_des: bytes
    pin: bytes
    asserted_fns: bytes[]
    load_label: bytes
    i_typ: float? = None
    i_max: float? = None


# A named net and its ordered pin references within one design block.
public record Net:
    name: bytes
    pins: PinRef[]


# A boundary port. rated_min/rated_max and nominal are volts; current_typ and
# current_max are expected/deliverable amperes. efficiency is a 0..1 conversion
# ratio used to charge upstream current as Iout * Vout/Vin / efficiency; linear
# means derive efficiency = Vout/Vin, so input current is approximately Iout.
# enable_net records the bring-up dependency; optional allows an open port.
# kind is its declared signal category, and side overrides direction-based board
# edge orientation. electrical is a virtual driver/receiver for cross-board ERC.
# diff_pair_of is the shared base key of the P/N ports expanded by diff-port;
# empty identifies an ordinary hand-written port.
public record Port:
    name: bytes
    net: bytes
    direction: bytes
    enable_net: bytes
    kind: bytes
    side: bytes
    diff_pair_of: bytes
    rated_min: float? = None
    rated_max: float? = None
    nominal: float? = None
    current_typ: float? = None
    current_max: float? = None
    efficiency: float? = None
    efficiency_linear: bool = False
    optional: bool = False
    electrical: ElectricalDecl? = None


# One expanded lane of a port-group: signal is the interface spelling, port is
# the expanded or renamed port, net is its physical net, and optional means ERC
# never requires the lane. Group membership lives beside ordinary ports because
# bundle validation and bridge-interface ask for the group's lanes.
public record PortGroupMember:
    signal: bytes
    port: bytes
    net: bytes
    optional: bool = False


# A boundary bus. name is the declared prefix (or interface name for an empty
# prefix), interface names its definition, and role is peripheral or controller
# with mirrored directions. Members refer to ordinary DesignBlock.ports.
public record PortGroup:
    name: bytes
    interface: bytes
    role: bytes
    members: PortGroupMember[]


# A note annotation attached to a reference designator.
public record Note:
    ref_des: bytes
    text: bytes


# A cited datasheet in lib/datasheets. page is 1-based; 0 links the whole PDF.
# quote is short verbatim source text auto-highlighted by the PDF viewer. Shared
# by section notes and library component requirements.
public record NoteRef:
    pdf: bytes
    page: int = 0
    quote: bytes? = None


# An intentionally inapplicable datasheet category. Strict preflight requires
# a rationale so an omitted topic cannot hide behind an unexplained N/A.
public record DatasheetReviewNa:
    category: bytes
    rationale: bytes


public enum DatasheetReviewStatus:
    draft
    complete
    stale


# Digest-bound evidence of an active component's datasheet review: its PDF,
# SHA-256, draft/complete/stale status, reviewer, ISO date, included categories
# and explicit category-na rationales. Preflight rehashes the current PDF, so
# replacing it makes the review stale even when the form was left unchanged.
public record DatasheetReview:
    datasheet: bytes
    sha256: bytes
    status: DatasheetReviewStatus
    reviewed_by: bytes
    date: bytes
    categories: bytes[]
    not_applicable: DatasheetReviewNa[]


# Design-specific section prose with an optional datasheet page reference.
public record SectionNote:
    text: bytes
    ref: NoteRef? = None


# A design-side sign-off answering a library or design rule. ref_des and
# stable target_id are alternatives; target_id survives renumbering and module
# renames. For design_rule both are empty and req_id identifies DesignRule.id.
# A failing machine check stays fail-with-override: prose cannot silently turn
# it into verified. A requirement without a check, or with an NA check, becomes
# verified on a matching sign-off. rationale is mandatory prose; signed_by/date
# retain optional signer and ISO-date provenance.
public record Verification:
    ref_des: bytes
    target_id: bytes
    req_id: bytes
    rationale: bytes
    signed_by: bytes
    date: bytes
    design_rule: bool = False


# A named virtual stub pin: class_ is a diagram wire category and net connects
# parts sharing the same net. Stubs expose logical signals, not physical pads.
public record PartSignal:
    name: bytes
    class_: bytes
    net: bytes


# A (stub ...) placeholder auto-places with ref_des and stable id, draws a
# categorized node wired through signals, and exports a padless width*height-mm
# box for floor planning (0 dimensions mean unset). A later real import of the
# same name supersedes it while keeping id and KiCad identity. role/mpn/category
# retain author intent; absent category permits name heuristics. channels draws
# stacked identical-channel cards; signals represent one channel.
public record PlaceholderPart:
    ref_des: bytes
    name: bytes
    role: bytes
    mpn: bytes
    category: bytes
    id: bytes
    signals: PartSignal[]
    width: float = 0.0
    height: float = 0.0
    channels: int = 1


# A library rule for using a component, with optional datasheet ref and a
# machine check. id is explicit source hex when provided, otherwise CRC32(text)
# written as eight lowercase hex digits. Sign-offs depend on it: freeze ids
# before editing linked requirement text to preserve verifies targets.
public record Requirement:
    text: bytes
    id: bytes
    ref: NoteRef? = None
    check: Check? = None


# Library rules are inherited datasheet obligations; design rules are authored
# by this board/module. Both are gated identically, retaining authority for review.
public enum RuleSource:
    library
    design


# One predicate of a design-owned net-rule, checked on every matched net:
# min_bulk_uf sums capacitors bridging the net to ground, declared_envelope
# requires an authored/derived envelope, in_net_class requires declared class
# membership, and max_fanout bounds its number of pins.
public enum NetPredicate:
    min_bulk_uf(value: float)
    declared_envelope
    in_net_class
    max_fanout(value: int)


# on_instance targets a part in the containing block (or sub/REF inside a
# sub-block) with an ordinary check. net_scoped requires every matched net from
# any glob to satisfy every predicate.
public enum DesignRuleBody:
    on_instance(target: bytes, check: Check)
    net_scoped(globs: bytes[], predicates: NetPredicate[])


# A rule owned by a design/block/section/module, entering the same result and
# verifies pipeline as a library requirement. id uses the same explicit-or-CRC
# scheme. scope is the authored section path for display; checking always uses
# the containing block regardless of that section path.
public record DesignRule:
    text: bytes
    id: bytes
    scope: bytes
    body: DesignRuleBody
    ref: NoteRef? = None


# Automated-check primitives attached to one placement's requirement. Pin
# references name pinout FUNCTIONS, not physical pad ids, because a pad's role
# and net depend on how that particular design wires it.
public enum Check:
    connected(pin_a: bytes, pin_b: bytes)
    decoupling(value: CheckDecoupling)
    pullup_range(pin: bytes, target_net: bytes, min_ohms: float, max_ohms: float)
    voltage_range(value: CheckVoltageRange)
    tied_to_net(pin: bytes, target_net: bytes)
    not_connected(pin: bytes)
    pin_not_floating(pin: bytes)
    pins_on_same_net(pins: bytes[])
    decoupling_per_pin(return_pin: bytes, pins: bytes[], min_uf: float, count: int)
    series_element(kind: SeriesKind, pin: bytes, target_net: bytes, min: float, max: float)
    feedback_divider(pin: bytes, return_net: bytes, reference_v: float, tolerance_pct: float)
    set_resistor_output(pin: bytes, return_net: bytes, output_pin: bytes, current_ua: float, tolerance_pct: float)
    cap_rating(pin_a: bytes, pin_b: bytes, min_ratio: float, min_v: float)
    max_distance(value: CheckMaxDistance)
    sequence(value: CheckSequence)


public record CheckDecoupling:
    pin_a: bytes
    pin_b: bytes
    min_uf: float
    max_uf: float? = None


public record CheckVoltageRange:
    pin: bytes
    min_v: float
    max_v: float
    not_above_pin: bytes
    margin_v: float = 0.0


public record CheckMaxDistance:
    pin: bytes
    kind: DistanceKind
    max_mm: float
    min_value: float? = None
    max_value: float? = None


public record CheckSequence:
    pin_a: bytes
    pin_b: bytes
    margin_ms: float = 0.0


public enum DistanceKind:
    C
    R
    L
    any


# A max-distance requirement resolved to a physical pad and candidate ref-des
# list. The layout lint can measure its budget without reparsing component values
# or loading pinouts; req_id/what retain the requirement and candidate meaning.
public record DistanceRule:
    req_id: bytes
    pad: bytes
    candidates: bytes[]
    max_mm: float
    what: bytes


public enum SeriesKind:
    R
    L
    C


# A named collection of member references.
public record Group:
    name: bytes
    members: bytes[]


# A functional super-block for the system view: name, what-it-does caption,
# authored section/sheet hosts (including synthetic Power), and optional stacked
# identical channels. stack > 1 draws offset cards.
public record FunctionSpec:
    name: bytes
    caption: bytes
    hosts: bytes[]
    stack: int = 1


# A part grouping inside an instance, for multi-part schematic symbols.
public record Part:
    name: bytes
    pins: PartPin[]


# A physical pin and its net, with optional pinout function pin_name and feature
# group label for the schematic master table's leftmost column.
public record PartPin:
    pin: bytes
    net: bytes
    pin_name: bytes
    group: bytes


# An authored component/instance key-value attribute, surfaced verbatim in the
# BOM and KiCad netlist (manufacturer, mpn and similar properties).
public record Property:
    key: bytes
    value: bytes


# An assembly variant changes population and value on the same PCB/netlist/
# footprint set. Structural changes require another board. doc is optional prose;
# one is_default declaration selects the variant when the user does not choose.
public record VariantDecl:
    name: bytes
    doc: bytes
    is_default: bool = False


# only_in permits population only in its variants; dnp_in excludes population;
# value_in overrides a populated part's value in exactly one variant.
public enum VariantRuleKind:
    only_in
    dnp_in
    value_in


# An instance-level clause retained for the whole population matrix. variant
# is validated against the root declarations; value is populated only by value_in.
public record VariantRule:
    kind: VariantRuleKind
    variant: bytes
    value: bytes


# Source-order rules survive materialization even though Instance.dnp/value
# already reflect the selected variant. base_value preserves the authored value
# before an override (empty when none applied), so BOM ledger fingerprints do
# not change just because a non-default assembly was built.
public record InstanceVariants:
    rules: VariantRule[]
    base_value: bytes


# The root design's variant space shared by every module evaluation and copied
# onto the finished block. active indexes decls; None means the implicit base.
public record VariantScope:
    decls: VariantDecl[]
    active: int? = None


# One placed library component, value/footprint/symbol and per-part pin breakup.
# label is source prose; origin_key is stable module-local source/structural
# identity, never rewritten by ref-des renumbering. pinout falls back to symbol/
# component. docs and requirements are copied from the library; ignored records
# an explicit opt-out. electrical stays sparse. attrs/typed_attrs retain authored
# ratings as well as merged properties, so a parts-table override can report a
# disagreement. distance_rules are resolved pad/candidate budgets. source_offset
# locates the family token; id is source hex and uuid is its KiCad/BOM identity.
# placeholder bypasses physical pad checks and warns until a real part replaces
# it. dnp retains copper/pads while excluding assembly population; variants
# explain the selected population/value. bind retains placement intent.
# strap_oks/nc_oks are physical-pad sign-offs with nonempty human reasons, never
# implicit suppressions. thermal and pinout_facts carry resolved evidence so
# consumers need no evaluator or second library read.
public record Instance:
    ref_des: bytes
    label: bytes
    origin_key: bytes
    component: bytes
    value: bytes
    footprint: bytes
    symbol: bytes
    pinout: bytes
    properties: Property[]
    docs: ComponentDocs
    requirements: Requirement[]
    electrical: ElectricalDecl[]
    attrs: bytes[]
    typed_attrs: Property[]
    distance_rules: DistanceRule[]
    parts: Part[]
    id: bytes
    uuid: bytes
    variants: InstanceVariants
    bind: InstanceBinds
    strap_oks: StrapOk[]
    nc_oks: NcOk[]
    thermal: InstanceThermal
    pinout_facts: PinoutFacts
    requirements_ignored: bool = False
    source_offset: int = 0
    placeholder: bool = False
    dnp: bool = False


# Structural evidence from the library pinout, rather than a weak ref-des
# letter (importers label many connectors/mechanical parts U). known=False means
# no evidence, not absence of a supply. has_supply excludes straps; has_ground
# includes exposed returns. positional means every function is merely its pad
# number. pin_count counts distinct pads and saturates instead of wrapping.
public record PinoutFacts:
    known: bool = False
    has_supply: bool = False
    has_ground: bool = False
    positional: bool = False
    pin_count: int = 0


# The part's lib/datasheets PDF names and digest-bound review, carried together
# through the cache/resolved component/instance. Legacy review=None warns during
# authoring and gates strict preflight until completeness is proven.
public record ComponentDocs:
    datasheets: bytes[]
    review: DatasheetReview? = None


public record ThermalDeclThetaJc:
    generic: float? = None
    top: float? = None
    bottom: float? = None


public record ThermalDeclPsi:
    jt: float? = None
    jb: float? = None


# Optional datasheet thermal envelope. Resistances are degrees C/W and
# temperatures degrees C. Missing theta_ja permits a package screening estimate;
# theta_jb supplies the junction-to-copper field path. theta_jc generic never
# guesses top/bottom direction; top/bottom are heat-flow resistances. psi values
# are characterization parameters retained for measurements, not resistances.
# tj_max is absolute junction maximum; operating_min/max bound rated ambient.
public record ThermalDecl:
    theta_jc: ThermalDeclThetaJc
    psi: ThermalDeclPsi
    theta_ja: float? = None
    theta_jb: float? = None
    tj_max: float? = None
    operating_min: float? = None
    operating_max: float? = None


# Authored instance dissipation in watts (typ alone or typ/max). It outranks
# derived current/regulator-loss estimates because it is the author's declaration.
public record PowerDecl:
    typ: float? = None
    max: float? = None


# Library thermal data and authored instance power, grouped because analyzers
# read them together. Missing power permits deriving dissipation from currents
# or regulator loss; missing decl means no library thermal declaration.
public record InstanceThermal:
    decl: ThermalDecl? = None
    power: PowerDecl? = None


# Bind a bypass capacitor to one named IC pad. Part and pad travel together:
# a bare pad number is ambiguous on a shared rail. Empty ic/pin means no binding
# (or automatic lowest supply pad); post-build resolution uses the TARGET pinout.
# rail=True deliberately serves the whole rail and opts out of per-pin binding,
# which differs from having no decouples form on a multi-pad supply.
public record DecoupleBind:
    ic: bytes
    pin: bytes
    rail: bool = False


# Adjacency to a named target pad for termination/feedback/matching/bulk parts.
# This has no return loop and never enters the inductance or plane-stitch score;
# a part carrying both near and decouple is an ERC error. The target pinout
# resolves ref/pin after build. Empty own infers the leg sharing the target net;
# author it when both legs share that net.
public record NearBind:
    ref: bytes
    pin: bytes
    own: bytes


# The authored decouple/near placement bindings, read together by all consumers.
public record InstanceBinds:
    decouple: DecoupleBind
    near: NearBind


# A physical-pad blessing for an intentional strap-to-rail tie. reason must be
# nonempty to suppress the strap_tied_to_rail error.
public record StrapOk:
    pin: bytes
    reason: bytes


# A physical-pad blessing for an intentional no-connect. A nonempty reason is
# required to suppress a finding for a declared input or config strap.
public record NcOk:
    pin: bytes
    reason: bytes


# A sub-block's name and design. source is its module key or project-relative
# file path for source/module viewers, empty when provenance is unavailable.
# reflow lets the parent's placer move the internal parts freely instead of
# docking the module's placement as one rigid macro.
public record SubBlock:
    name: bytes
    block: DesignBlock
    source: bytes
    reflow: bool = False


# Top-level instance pins referenced inside a section, with an optional feature label.
public record PinGroup:
    ref_des: bytes
    pins: PartPin[]
    group: bytes


# Signal categories for section interfaces.
public enum SignalType:
    power
    signal
    clock
    data
    differential
    rf


# Section port flow: in_ consumes, out produces, io is bidirectional.
public enum PortDirection:
    in_
    out
    io


# An evaluated and ordered rated-voltage window (min <= max).
public record RatedWindow:
    min: float
    max: float


# A section boundary interface. voltage is evaluated nominal volts; rated is
# an optional pair recording authored bounds without seeding a rail envelope
# (the section is not the source). group groups bus/differential lanes; role and
# protocol are annotations. class_ is authoritative diagram edge class before
# signal_type/name heuristics. optional permits an open connection; electrical
# supplies virtual boundary driver/receiver evidence for voltage-domain ERC.
public record SectionPort:
    name: bytes
    direction: PortDirection
    signal_type: SignalType
    group: bytes[]
    role: bytes
    protocol: bytes
    class_: bytes
    voltage: float? = None
    rated: RatedWindow? = None
    optional: bool = False
    electrical: ElectricalDecl? = None


# A named calculation with key-value results for section review display.
public record CalcBlock:
    name: bytes
    results: CalcResult[]


# One named scalar result showing design intent beside its implementing parts.
public record CalcResult:
    name: bytes
    value: float


# Concept has interfaces only; implemented has components; review flags an implementation.
public enum SectionStatus:
    concept
    implemented
    review


# An authored section of instances/pin groups/interfaces/protocols/calcs. category
# is authoritative before block_role/name heuristics; notes link design prose to
# datasheet pages. Subsections show schematic detail but merge in block diagrams.
# status can be inferred from content. diagram_hidden removes noisy mechanical/
# instrumentation groups from overview. hosts explicitly folds named sub-blocks
# into this node, overriding the layout-independent net-count attachment heuristic.
public record Section:
    name: bytes
    description: bytes
    category: bytes
    notes: SectionNote[]
    instances: Instance[]
    pin_groups: PinGroup[]
    ports: SectionPort[]
    protocols: bytes[]
    calcs: CalcBlock[]
    sub_sections: Section[]
    status: SectionStatus
    block_role: BlockRole
    hosts: bytes[]
    diagram_hidden: bool = False


# Block-diagram placement role: automatic, input source or output sink.
public enum BlockRole:
    auto
    input
    output


# Merge the named net b onto net a.
public record NetTie:
    a: bytes
    b: bytes


# Library pin role for driver/receiver voltage-domain ERC and future signal analysis.
public enum ElectricalType:
    input
    output
    io
    power_in
    power_out
    passive
    nc


# Output style: open-drain needs an external pull-up for a high level.
public enum Drive:
    push_pull
    open_drain
    open_emitter


# Sparse electrical metadata indexed by pin FUNCTION name, surviving pinout
# regeneration. No entry means skip that pin. Optional levels are volts;
# max_voltage is absolute maximum and domain_ names digital/analog/rf provenance.
public record ElectricalDecl:

# escape_mm<0 defaults to 1mm for RF; explicit 0 disables straight escape.
# min_bend_ratio=0 uses the 3x floor; larger values also raise smoothing aim.
# mask_relief_mm<0 defaults on at mask margin for RF, off for ordinary classes;

public func value_as_number(self: Value) -> float?:
    match self:
        case Value.number(value=n):
            return Some(n)
        case _:
            return None


public func value_as_string(self: Value) -> bytes?:
    match self:
        case Value.string(value=s):
            return Some(s.copy())
        case _:
            return None


public func value_as_bool(self: Value) -> bool?:
    match self:
        case Value.boolean(value=b):

    match self:

            return n != 0.0
        case _:

public func parse_note_ref(node: ast.Node) -> NoteRef?:
    mut children = try ast.as_list(node)
    if len(children) < 2:
        return None
    mut head = try ast.as_atom(children[0])
    if head != b"ref":
        return None
    mut pdf = try ast.as_string(children[1])
    mut page = 0
    mut quote: bytes? = None
    for child in children[2:]:
        mut subs = ast.as_list(child)
        if subs is None:
            continue
        if len(subs) < 2:
            continue
        mut sub_head = ast.as_atom(subs[0])
        if sub_head is None:
            continue
        if sub_head == b"page":
            mut n = ast.as_number(subs[1])
            if n is not None:
                mut p = numeric.checked_u32(n)
                if p is not None:
                    page = int(p)
        elif sub_head == b"quote":
            mut s = ast.as_string(subs[1])
            if s is not None:
                quote = Some(s.copy())
    return Some(NoteRef(pdf=pdf, page=page, quote=quote))

    mut i = 0
    while i < len(self.decls):

            return Some(i)
        i += 1
    return None


public func variant_scope_default_index(self: VariantScope) -> int?:

    while i < len(self.decls):

            return Some(i)
        i += 1
    return None

    for layer in self.copper:

    for layer2 in self.dielectrics:

public func net_class_spec_voltage_drop_valid(self: NetClassSpecVoltageDrop) -> bool:
    mut valid_limit = math.is_finite(self.limit_v) and self.limit_v > 0.0
    mut valid_temperature = math.is_finite(self.copper_temperature_c) and self.copper_temperature_c >= -50.0 and self.copper_temperature_c <= 200.0
    return valid_limit and valid_temperature and len(self.return_net) > 0

public func env_init(mut pool: EnvPool, parent: Env?) -> Env:
    mut scope = Env(index=len(pool.scopes))
    pool.scopes.append(EnvScope(bindings={}, parent=parent))
    return scope


public func env_put(mut pool: EnvPool, self: Env, name: bytes, value: Value):
    pool.scopes[self.index].bindings[strs.text(name)] = value.copy()


public func env_get(pool: EnvPool, self: Env, name: bytes) -> Value?:
    mut key = strs.text(name)
    if key in pool.scopes[self.index].bindings:
        return Some(pool.scopes[self.index].bindings[key].copy())
    mut parent = pool.scopes[self.index].parent
    if parent is None:
        return None
    return env_get(pool, parent, name)

public func kicad_name_is_unsafe(name: bytes) -> bool:
    return len(name) == 0 or name.find(b"/") >= 0 or name.find(b"\\") >= 0 or name.find(b"..") >= 0


public func sanitize_kicad_name(err: Stream, kicad_name: bytes) -> bytes:
    if not kicad_name_is_unsafe(kicad_name):
        return kicad_name.copy()
    mut w = byte_builder.create()
    if len(kicad_name) == 0:
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b"_")
    else:
        for c in kicad_name:
            mut replacement = c
            if c == 47 or c == 92 or c == 46:
                replacement = 95
            _ = byte_builder.append_byte(mut w, replacement)
    mut safe = byte_builder.finish(w)
    log.warn(err, b"export-kicad: unsafe footprint name '" + kicad_name + b"' sanitized to '" + safe + b"' (path-traversal guard)")
    return safe


func build_pad_map(fs: Filesystem, instances: flat_netlist.FlatInstance[], project_dir: str) -> dict[str, bytes[]]:
    mut fp_pad_map: dict[str, bytes[]] = {}
    for inst in instances:
        mut key = strs.text(inst.footprint)
        if len(inst.footprint) == 0 or key in fp_pad_map:
            continue
        mut fp_src = stdlib.read(fs, project_dir, "lib/footprints/" + key + ".sexp", lib_limits.max_footprint_bytes)
        if fp_src is None:
            continue
        match netlist_mod.extract_pad_names(fp_src):
            case Err(_):
                continue
            case Ok(pads):
                fp_pad_map[key] = pads
    return fp_pad_map


public func export_kicad(fs: Filesystem, err: Stream, block: env_mod.DesignBlock, project_dir: str, output_dir: str, design_name: bytes, opts: BundleOptions) -> Result[Unit, str]:
    mut fp_dir = output_dir + "/footprints.pretty"
    mut model_dir = output_dir + "/models"
    match infra_fs.make_path(fs, output_dir):
        case Err(e):
            log.warn(err, f"Failed to create output dir {output_dir.copy()}: {e.copy()}".encode())
            return Err(e)
        case Ok(_):
            pass
    match infra_fs.make_path(fs, fp_dir):
        case Err(e2):
            log.warn(err, f"Failed to create footprints dir: {e2.copy()}".encode())
            return Err(e2)
        case Ok(_):
            pass
    match infra_fs.make_path(fs, model_dir):
        case Err(e3):
            log.warn(err, f"Failed to create models dir: {e3.copy()}".encode())
            return Err(e3)
        case Ok(_):
            pass
    mut instances: flat_netlist.FlatInstance[] = []
    mut nets: flat_netlist.FlatNet[] = []
    flat_netlist.collect_instances(block, b"", mut instances)
    flat_netlist.flatten_and_merge_nets(block, mut nets)
    mut fp_name_map: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    mut processed_fps: set[str] = set()
    mut fp_components: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    mut seen_kicad_names: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    mut model_cfg = model_mod.load_model_config(fs, project_dir)
    for inst in instances:
        mut key = strs.text(inst.footprint)
        if len(inst.footprint) == 0 or key in processed_fps:
            continue
        processed_fps.add(key.copy())
        fp_components[key.copy()] = inst.component.copy()
        mut fp_sub = "lib/footprints/" + key + ".sexp"
        mut fp_source = stdlib.read(fs, project_dir, fp_sub, lib_limits.max_footprint_bytes)
        if fp_source is None:
            log.warn(err, f"cannot read footprint {fp_sub} under {project_dir.copy()} or the standard library".encode())
            fp_name_map[key] = inst.footprint.copy()
            continue
        mut declared_name = inst.footprint.copy()
        match netlist_mod.extract_footprint_name(fp_source):
            case Ok(name):
                declared_name = name
            case Err(_):
                pass
        mut kicad_name = sanitize_kicad_name(err, declared_name)
        mut nk = strs.text(kicad_name)
        if nk in seen_kicad_names:
            mut first = seen_kicad_names[nk].copy()
            if first != inst.footprint:
                log.warn(err, b"export-kicad: footprints '" + first + b"' and '" + inst.footprint + b"' both declare KiCad name '" + kicad_name + b"' \xe2\x80\x94 the .kicad_mod will be overwritten")
        else:
            seen_kicad_names[nk.copy()] = inst.footprint.copy()
        fp_name_map[key.copy()] = kicad_name.copy()
        mut model_name: bytes? = None
        mut model_offset: float[]? = None
        mut model_rotation: float[]? = None
        if key in model_cfg:
            mut cfg = model_cfg[key].copy()
            model_name = cfg.model.copy()
            model_offset = Some(cfg.offset.copy())
            model_rotation = Some(cfg.rotation.copy())
        if model_name is None:
            model_name = footprint_mod.find_model_file(fs, project_dir, inst.footprint, inst.component)
        mut mod_output = b""
        match model_mod.build_kicad_mod(fs, err, project_dir, inst.footprint, fp_source, model_name, model_offset, model_rotation):
            case Err(e4):
                log.warn(err, b"failed to convert footprint " + inst.footprint + b": " + e4.encode())
                continue
            case Ok(converted):
                mod_output = converted
        mut mod_path = fp_dir + "/" + nk + ".kicad_mod"
        try infra_fs.write_file(fs, mod_path, mod_output)
        log.progress(err, f"  Wrote {mod_path}".encode())
        if model_name is not None:
            mut src_path = project_dir + "/lib/models/" + strs.text(model_name)
            mut dst_path = model_dir + "/" + strs.text(model_name)
            match infra_fs.copy_file(fs, src_path, dst_path):
                case Err(e5):
                    log.warn(err, b"failed to copy model " + model_name + b": " + e5.encode())
                case Ok(_):
                    pass
            log.progress(err, b"  Copied model " + model_name)
    mut net_path = output_dir + "/" + strs.text(design_name) + ".net"
    mut fp_pad_map = build_pad_map(fs, instances, project_dir)
    mut netlist = netlist_mod.write_netlist(design_name, instances, nets, fp_name_map, fp_pad_map)
    try infra_fs.write_file(fs, net_path, netlist)
    log.progress(err, f"  Wrote {net_path}".encode())
    if opts.schematic:
        try write_schematic_into(fs, err, block, project_dir, output_dir, design_name)
    return Ok(())


func write_schematic_into(fs: Filesystem, err: Stream, block: env_mod.DesignBlock, project_dir: str, output_dir: str, design_name: bytes) -> Result[Unit, str]:
    mut output = try sch_mod.export_sch(fs, err, block, project_dir, design_name, sch_mod.Options())
    for f in output.files:
        mut path = strs.path_join([output_dir.copy(), strs.text(f.name)])
        try infra_fs.write_file(fs, path, f.bytes)
        log.progress(err, f"  Wrote {path}".encode())
    for f2 in output.sidecars:
        mut path2 = strs.path_join([output_dir.copy(), strs.text(f2.name)])
        if fs.exists(path2):
            continue
        try infra_fs.write_file(fs, path2, f2.bytes)
        log.progress(err, f"  Wrote {path2}".encode())
    return Ok(())

public func export_kicad_entries(fs: Filesystem, err: Stream, block: env_mod.DesignBlock, project_dir: str, design_name: bytes, opts: BundleOptions) -> Result[zipfile.Entry[], str]:
    mut instances: flat_netlist.FlatInstance[] = []
    mut nets: flat_netlist.FlatNet[] = []
    flat_netlist.collect_instances(block, b"", mut instances)
    flat_netlist.flatten_and_merge_nets(block, mut nets)
    mut fp_name_map: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    mut processed_fps: set[str] = set()
    mut seen_kicad_names: dict[str, bytes] = {}
    mut zip_files: zipfile.Entry[] = []
    mut model_cfg = model_mod.load_model_config(fs, project_dir)
    for inst in instances:
        mut key = strs.text(inst.footprint)
        if len(inst.footprint) == 0 or key in processed_fps:
            continue
        processed_fps.add(key.copy())
        mut fp_source = stdlib.read(fs, project_dir, "lib/footprints/" + key + ".sexp", lib_limits.max_footprint_bytes)
        if fp_source is None:
            fp_name_map[key] = inst.footprint.copy()
            continue
        mut declared_name = inst.footprint.copy()
        match netlist_mod.extract_footprint_name(fp_source):
            case Ok(name):
                declared_name = name
            case Err(_):
                pass
        mut kicad_name = sanitize_kicad_name(err, declared_name)
        mut nk = strs.text(kicad_name)
        if nk in seen_kicad_names:
            mut first = seen_kicad_names[nk].copy()
            if first != inst.footprint:
                log.warn(err, b"export-kicad: footprints '" + first + b"' and '" + inst.footprint + b"' both declare KiCad name '" + kicad_name + b"' \xe2\x80\x94 the .kicad_mod will be overwritten in the zip")
        else:
            seen_kicad_names[nk.copy()] = inst.footprint.copy()
        fp_name_map[key.copy()] = kicad_name.copy()
        mut model_name: bytes? = None
        mut model_offset: float[]? = None
        mut model_rotation: float[]? = None
        if key in model_cfg:
            mut cfg = model_cfg[key].copy()
            model_name = cfg.model.copy()
            model_offset = Some(cfg.offset.copy())
            model_rotation = Some(cfg.rotation.copy())
        if model_name is None:
            model_name = footprint_mod.find_model_file(fs, project_dir, inst.footprint, inst.component)
        mut mod_output = b""
        match model_mod.build_kicad_mod(fs, err, project_dir, inst.footprint, fp_source, model_name, model_offset, model_rotation):
            case Err(_):
                continue
            case Ok(converted):
                mod_output = converted
        zip_files.append(zipfile.Entry(name=b"footprints.pretty/" + kicad_name + b".kicad_mod", data=mod_output))
        if model_name is not None:
            mut src_path = project_dir + "/lib/models/" + strs.text(model_name)
            match infra_fs.read_file_alloc(fs, src_path, 20971520):
                case Err(_):
                    continue
                case Ok(model_data):
                    zip_files.append(zipfile.Entry(name=b"models/" + model_name, data=model_data))
    mut fp_pad_map = build_pad_map(fs, instances, project_dir)
    mut netlist = netlist_mod.write_netlist(design_name, instances, nets, fp_name_map, fp_pad_map)
    zip_files.append(zipfile.Entry(name=design_name + b".net", data=netlist))
    if opts.schematic:
        mut sch = try sch_mod.export_sch(fs, err, block, project_dir, design_name, sch_mod.Options())
        for f in sch.files:
            zip_files.append(zipfile.Entry(name=f.name.copy(), data=f.bytes.copy()))
        for f2 in sch.sidecars:
            zip_files.append(zipfile.Entry(name=f2.name.copy(), data=f2.bytes.copy()))
    return Ok(zip_files)


public func export_kicad_zip(fs: Filesystem, err: Stream, block: env_mod.DesignBlock, project_dir: str, design_name: bytes, opts: BundleOptions) -> Result[bytes, str]:
    mut zip_files = try export_kicad_entries(fs, err, block, project_dir, design_name, opts)
    mut zw = byte_builder.create()
    try zipfile.write(mut zw, zip_files)
    return Ok(byte_builder.finish(zw))

func render(out: Stream, source: bytes) -> bytes:
    match m.export_footprint_mod(out, source, None, None, None):
        case Ok(data):
            return data
        case Err(e):
            out.print(e)
            assert False, "footprint export failed"
            return b""


func write_footprint(fs: Filesystem, name: str, source: bytes) -> bool:
    match fsx.make_path(fs, "project/lib/footprints"):
        case Err(_):
            return False
        case Ok(_):
            pass
    match fs.write_file("project/lib/footprints/" + name + ".sexp", source):
        case Err(_):
            return False
        case Ok(_):
            return True


# Original private Zig test helper: inspect the emitted nth pad placement.
func nth_pad_at_angle(mod: bytes, n: int) -> float?:
    mut seen = 0
    for line in strs.tokenize_scalar(mod, 10):
        mut t = strs.trim(line, b" \t\r")
        if not t.startswith(b"(at ") or not t.endswith(b")"):
            continue
        if seen != n:
            seen += 1
            continue
        mut fields = strs.tokenize_scalar(t[4:len(t) - 1], 32)
        if len(fields) < 3:
            return None
        return support_parse.parse_float(strs.text(fields[2]))
    return None


# test "exportFootprintMod emits the pad rotation geometry.zig reads, mapped into KiCad's frame"
public func test_exportfootprintmod_emits_the_pad_rotation_geometry_zig_reads_mapped_into_kicad_s_frame(fs: Filesystem, out: Stream) -> bool:
    mut src = b"(footprint \"rot-fixture\"\n  (pad 1 smd rect (pos 1.0 2.0 45) (size 1.2 0.6))\n  (pad 2 smd rect (pos -1.0 2.0) (size 1.2 0.6))\n  (pad 3 smd roundrect (pos 0.0 -2.0 -30) (size 1.2 0.6)))"
    assert write_footprint(fs, "rot-fixture", src)
    mut geom = geometry.load(fs, "project", b"rot-fixture", 0, 0.0)
    assert not geom.fallback
    assert len(geom.pads) == 3
    mut result = render(out, src)
    for i in range(len(geom.pads)):
        mut want = m.kicad_pad_angle(geom.pads[i].rot)
        mut got = nth_pad_at_angle(result, i)
        if want == 0.0:
            assert got is None
        else:
            if got is None:
                return False
            assert ex.near(out, "pad angle", got, want, 1e-4)
    assert result.find(b"(at 1.0000 2.0000 315.0000)") >= 0
    assert result.find(b"(at -1.0000 2.0000)") >= 0
    assert result.find(b"(at 0.0000 -2.0000 30.0000)") >= 0
    assert result.find(b"(size 1.2000 0.6000)") >= 0
    return True

# test "useSourceKicadMod replaces a (model …) block whose path holds a parenthesis"
public func test_usesourcekicadmod_replaces_a_model_block_whose_path_holds_a_parenthesis(out: Stream) -> bool:
    mut src = b"(footprint \"Vendor\"\n  (pad \"1\" smd rect (at 0 0) (size 1 1) (layers \"F.Cu\"))\n  (model \"${KIPRJMOD}/3d/Part(rev2).step\"\n    (offset (xyz 9 9 9))\n    (scale (xyz 1 1 1))\n    (rotate (xyz 7 7 7))\n  )\n)"
    match m.use_source_kicad_mod(src, Some(b"new.step"), None, None):
        case Err(_):
            return False
        case Ok(result):
            assert result.find(b"Part(rev2).step") < 0
            assert result.find(b"(xyz 9 9 9)") < 0
            assert result.find(b"(xyz 7 7 7)") < 0
            assert result.find(b"(model \"${KIPRJMOD}/models/new.step\"") >= 0
            assert ex.eq_int(out, "one model reference", result.count(b"(model "), 1)
            match parser_mod.parse(result):
                case Err(_):
                    return False
                case Ok(nodes):
                    assert len(nodes) == 1
    mut truncated = b"(footprint \"V\"\n  (model \"x.step\"\n    (offset (xyz 0 0 0))"
    match m.use_source_kicad_mod(truncated, Some(b"new.step"), None, None):
        case Err(e):
            assert e == m.err_invalid_format
        case Ok(_):
            return False
    return True

public record ModelTransform:
    offset: float[]
    rotation: float[]
    model: bytes? = None


public func load_model_config(fs: Filesystem, project_dir: str) -> dict[str, ModelTransform]:
    mut map: dict[str, ModelTransform] = {}
    mut content = b""
    match infra_fs.read_file_alloc(fs, project_dir + "/lib/models/model-config.json", 1048576):
        case Err(_):
            return map
        case Ok(data):
            content = data
    mut pos = 0
    while pos < len(content):
        mut q1 = strs.index_of_pos(content, pos, b"\"")
        if q1 < 0:
            break
        mut q2 = strs.index_of_pos(content, q1 + 1, b"\"")
        if q2 < 0:
            break
        mut key = content[q1 + 1:q2]
        mut brace = strs.index_of_pos(content, q2, b"{")
        if brace < 0:
            break
        mut brace_end = strs.index_of_pos(content, brace, b"}")
        if brace_end < 0:
            break
        mut obj = content[brace:brace_end + 1]
        mut transform = ModelTransform(offset=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0], rotation=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
        mut os = obj.find(b"\"offset\":[")
        if os >= 0:
            mut arr_start = os + 10
            mut arr_end = strs.index_of_pos(obj, arr_start, b"]")
            if arr_end >= 0:
                transform.offset = parse_float3(obj[arr_start:arr_end])
        mut rs = obj.find(b"\"rotation\":[")
        if rs >= 0:
            mut rotation_start = rs + 12
            mut rotation_end = strs.index_of_pos(obj, rotation_start, b"]")
            if rotation_end >= 0:
                transform.rotation = parse_float3(obj[rotation_start:rotation_end])
        mut ms = obj.find(b"\"model\":\"")
        if ms >= 0:
            mut val_start = ms + 9
            mut val_end = strs.index_of_pos(obj, val_start, b"\"")
            if val_end >= 0:
                transform.model = Some(obj[val_start:val_end])
        map[strs.text(key)] = transform
        pos = brace_end + 1
    return map


public func parse_float3(s: bytes) -> float[]:
    mut result = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    mut idx = 0
    for part in s.split(b","):
        if idx >= 3:
            break
        mut trimmed = strs.trim(part, b" \t\n\r")
        result[idx] = parse_mod.parse_float(strs.text(trimmed)).unwrap_or(0.0)
        idx += 1
    return result


public func build_kicad_mod(fs: Filesystem, err: Stream, project_dir: str, fp_name: bytes, fp_sexp_source: bytes, model_name: bytes?, model_offset: float[]?, model_rotation: float[]?) -> Result[bytes, str]:
    mut src_path = footprint_mod.find_source_kicad_mod(fs, project_dir, fp_name)
    if src_path is not None:
        match infra_fs.read_file_alloc(fs, src_path, 10485760):
            case Ok(original):
                return footprint_mod.use_source_kicad_mod(original, model_name, model_offset, model_rotation)
            case Err(_):
                pass
    return footprint_mod.export_footprint_mod(err, fp_sexp_source, model_name, model_offset, model_rotation)


public func export_footprints(fs: Filesystem, err: Stream, block: env_mod.DesignBlock, project_dir: str, output_pretty_dir: str) -> Result[Unit, str]:
    mut pretty_parent = strs.path_dirname(output_pretty_dir).unwrap_or(".").copy()
    mut model_dir = pretty_parent + "/models"
    try infra_fs.make_path(fs, model_dir)
    mut instances: flat_netlist.FlatInstance[] = []
    flat_netlist.collect_instances(block, b"", mut instances)
    mut processed_fps: set[str] = set()
    mut model_cfg = load_model_config(fs, project_dir)
    for inst in instances:
        if len(inst.footprint) == 0:
            continue
        mut key = strs.text(inst.footprint)
        if key in processed_fps:
            continue
        processed_fps.add(key.copy())
        mut fp_source = stdlib.read(fs, project_dir, "lib/footprints/" + key + ".sexp", lib_limits.max_footprint_bytes)
        if fp_source is None:
            continue
        mut kicad_name = inst.footprint.copy()
        match netlist_mod.extract_footprint_name(fp_source):
            case Ok(name):
                kicad_name = name
            case Err(_):
                pass
        mut model_name: bytes? = None
        mut model_offset: float[]? = None
        mut model_rotation: float[]? = None
        if key in model_cfg:
            mut cfg = model_cfg[key].copy()
            model_name = cfg.model.copy()
            model_offset = Some(cfg.offset.copy())
            model_rotation = Some(cfg.rotation.copy())
        if model_name is None:
            model_name = footprint_mod.find_model_file(fs, project_dir, inst.footprint, inst.component)
        mut mod_output = b""
        match build_kicad_mod(fs, err, project_dir, inst.footprint, fp_source, model_name, model_offset, model_rotation):
            case Err(_):
                continue
            case Ok(data):
                mod_output = data
        mut mod_path = output_pretty_dir + "/" + strs.text(kicad_name) + ".kicad_mod"
        # Whole-file Filesystem write is the D4 create/write adapter.
        match infra_fs.write_file(fs, mod_path, mod_output):
            case Err(_):
                # G30/D4: write_file combines create/write errors. Preserve the
                # tolerated-create-failure path; later write failure is merged.
                continue
            case Ok(_):
                pass
        if model_name is not None:
            mut source = project_dir + "/lib/models/" + strs.text(model_name)
            mut dest = model_dir + "/" + strs.text(model_name)
            match infra_fs.copy_file(fs, source, dest):
                case Err(e):
                    log.warn(err, b"copy " + model_name + b": " + e.encode())
                case Ok(_):
                    pass
    return Ok(())


record FlatSection:
    name: bytes
    instances: env_mod.Instance[]
    pin_groups: env_mod.PinGroup[]


public func export_section_layout(block: env_mod.DesignBlock) -> bytes:
    mut flat_sections: FlatSection[] = []
    for sec in block.sections:
        if len(sec.sub_sections) > 0:
            flat_sections.append(FlatSection(name=sec.name.copy(), instances=[], pin_groups=sec.pin_groups.copy()))
        else:
            flat_sections.append(FlatSection(name=sec.name.copy(), instances=sec.instances.copy(), pin_groups=sec.pin_groups.copy()))
        for sub in sec.sub_sections:
            flat_sections.append(FlatSection(name=sub.name.copy(), instances=sub.instances.copy(), pin_groups=sub.pin_groups.copy()))
    mut n = len(flat_sections)
    if n == 0:
        return b"{\"cell_size_mm\":50,\"sections\":[],\"ref_section\":{}}"
    mut n_cols = 1
    while n_cols * n_cols < n:
        n_cols += 1
    mut ref_map: dict[str, int] = {}
    for si in range(n):
        mut sec2 = flat_sections[si].copy()
        for inst in sec2.instances:
            ref_map[strs.text(inst.ref_des)] = si
        for pg in sec2.pin_groups:
            if strs.text(pg.ref_des) not in ref_map:
                ref_map[strs.text(pg.ref_des)] = si
    mut w = byte_builder.create()
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"{\"cell_size_mm\":50,\"sections\":[")
    for si2 in range(n):
        mut sec3 = flat_sections[si2].copy()
        if si2 > 0:
            byte_builder.append(mut w, b",")
        mut row = si2 // n_cols
        mut col = si2 % n_cols
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b"{\"name\":\"" + sec3.name)
        byte_builder.append_text(mut w, "\",\"row\":" + str(row) + ",\"col\":" + str(col) + ",\"refs\":[")
        mut first = True
        for inst2 in sec3.instances:
            if not first:
                byte_builder.append(mut w, b",")
            byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\"" + inst2.ref_des + b"\"")
            first = False
        for pg2 in sec3.pin_groups:
            mut found = False
            for inst3 in sec3.instances:
                if inst3.ref_des == pg2.ref_des:
                    found = True
                    break
            if not found:
                if not first:
                    byte_builder.append(mut w, b",")
                byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\"" + pg2.ref_des + b"\"")
                first = False
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b"]}")
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"],\"ref_section\":{")
    mut ref_first = True
    for ref in ref_map:
        if not ref_first:
            byte_builder.append(mut w, b",")
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\"" + ref.encode() + b"\":")
        byte_builder.append_text(mut w, str(ref_map[ref]))
        ref_first = False
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"}}")
    return byte_builder.finish(w)

# Test fixtures are constructed from the same ordered Zig tables. Defaults
# come from the environment helpers, without copying recursive identity.
func ic(ref: bytes, component: bytes) -> env.Instance:
    mut value = env.instance_default(ref)
    value.component = component.copy()
    return value


func cap(ref: bytes) -> env.Instance:
    mut value = ic(ref, b"cap-0402")
    value.value = b"100nF"
    return value


func resistor(ref: bytes, value: bytes) -> env.Instance:
    mut instance = ic(ref, b"res-0402")
    instance.value = value.copy()
    return instance


func pin(ref: bytes, number: bytes) -> env.PinRef:
    return env.pin_ref_default(ref, number)


func net(name: bytes, pins: env.PinRef[]) -> env.Net:
    return env.Net(name=name.copy(), pins=pins.copy())


func section(name: bytes, instances: env.Instance[]) -> env.Section:
    mut result = env.section_default(name)
    result.instances = instances.copy()
    return result


func block(name: bytes, instances: env.Instance[], nets: env.Net[], sections: env.Section[]) -> env.DesignBlock:
    mut result = env.design_block_default(name)
    result.instances = instances.copy()
    result.nets = nets.copy()
    result.sections = sections.copy()
    return result

func export_output(fs: Filesystem, out: Stream, value: env.DesignBlock, name: bytes, opts: m.Options) -> m.Output:
    match m.export_sch(fs, out, value, "/nonexistent", name, opts):
        case Ok(result):
            return result
        case Err(e):
            out.print(e)
            assert False, "schematic export failed"
            return m.Output(files=[], sidecars=[], stats=m.Stats())


func export_root(fs: Filesystem, out: Stream, value: env.DesignBlock, name: bytes) -> bytes:
    mut result = export_output(fs, out, value, name, m.Options())
    return result.files[0].bytes.copy()

func stub_block() -> env.DesignBlock:
    mut instances = [ic(b"U1", b"acme-mcu"), cap(b"C1"), cap(b"C2"), resistor(b"R1", b"0R"), ic(b"U2", b"acme-io")]
    mut nets = [net(b"V1P8", [pin(b"R1", b"2"), pin(b"U2", b"1")]), net(b"V1P8.U1.1", [pin(b"U1", b"1"), pin(b"C1", b"1")]), net(b"V1P8.U1.2", [pin(b"U1", b"2"), pin(b"C2", b"1")]), net(b"GND", [pin(b"U1", b"3"), pin(b"C1", b"2"), pin(b"C2", b"2")]), net(b"3.3V_SENSE", [pin(b"U1", b"4"), pin(b"R1", b"1")])]
    return block(b"Stub Board", instances, nets, [section(b"Core System", instances[0:3]), section(b"Rail", instances[3:5])])


func bypass(ref: bytes, pad: bytes) -> env.Instance:
    mut result = cap(ref)
    mut binds = result.bind.copy()
    binds.decouple = env.DecoupleBind(ic=b"U1", pin=pad.copy())
    result.bind = binds
    return result


func wire_block() -> env.DesignBlock:
    mut instances = [ic(b"U1", b"acme-mcu"), bypass(b"C1", b"1"), bypass(b"C2", b"5"), resistor(b"R1", b"10k"), resistor(b"R2", b"10k"), ic(b"U2", b"acme-io")]
    # First-seen net order determines pad edges and the nonoverlapping chain.
    # C2 returns only to AGND, so the two declared bypasses cannot gang.
    mut nets = [net(b"VDD3V3", [pin(b"U1", b"1"), pin(b"U1", b"5"), pin(b"C1", b"1"), pin(b"C2", b"1")]), net(b"AGND", [pin(b"C2", b"2")]), net(b"SPARE1", [pin(b"R1", b"1")]), net(b"TAP", [pin(b"U1", b"3"), pin(b"R1", b"2"), pin(b"R2", b"1")]), net(b"GND", [pin(b"U1", b"2"), pin(b"C1", b"2")]), net(b"LINK", [pin(b"U1", b"4"), pin(b"U2", b"1")]), net(b"SPARE2", [pin(b"R2", b"2")])]
    return block(b"Wired Board", instances, nets, [section(b"Core System", instances[0:5]), section(b"IO Bank", instances[5:6])])


func gang_block() -> env.DesignBlock:
    mut c4 = bypass(b"C4", b"1")
    c4.value = b"10uF"
    mut instances = [ic(b"U1", b"acme-mcu"), bypass(b"C1", b"1"), bypass(b"C2", b"1"), bypass(b"C3", b"1"), c4, cap(b"C5")]
    mut nets = [net(b"VDD3V3", [pin(b"U1", b"1"), pin(b"C1", b"1"), pin(b"C2", b"1"), pin(b"C3", b"1"), pin(b"C4", b"1")]), net(b"VDDA", [pin(b"U1", b"3"), pin(b"C5", b"1")]), net(b"GND", [pin(b"U1", b"2"), pin(b"C1", b"2"), pin(b"C2", b"2"), pin(b"C3", b"2"), pin(b"C4", b"2"), pin(b"C5", b"2")])]
    return block(b"Ganged Board", instances, nets, [section(b"Core System", instances)])


func edge_block() -> env.DesignBlock:
    mut instances = [ic(b"U1", b"acme-mcu")]
    mut nets = [net(b"GND", [pin(b"U1", b"1"), pin(b"U1", b"2"), pin(b"U1", b"3")]), net(b"VDD3V3", [pin(b"U1", b"4"), pin(b"U1", b"5")]), net(b"SIG", [pin(b"U1", b"6")])]
    return block(b"Edge Board", instances, nets, [section(b"Core", instances)])


func mpn_block() -> env.DesignBlock:
    mut u1 = ic(b"U1", b"acme-mcu")
    u1.value = b"ACME-100"
    u1.properties = [env.Property(key=b"mpn", value=b"ACME-100-QFN48"), env.Property(key=b"manufacturer", value=b"Acme")]
    mut c1 = cap(b"C1")
    c1.properties = [env.Property(key=b"mpn", value=b"GRM155R71C104KA88D")]
    mut u2 = ic(b"U2", b"acme-io")
    u2.value = b"ACME-200"
    mut instances = [u1, c1, u2]
    mut nets = [net(b"VDD3V3", [pin(b"U1", b"1"), pin(b"C1", b"1"), pin(b"U2", b"1")]), net(b"GND", [pin(b"U1", b"2"), pin(b"C1", b"2"), pin(b"U2", b"2")])]
    return block(b"Part Number Board", instances, nets, [section(b"Core", instances)])


func cap_index(i: int) -> int:
    return (if (i <= 12) then (i) else (i + 1))


func pwr_block() -> env.DesignBlock:
    return block(b"LDO", [ic(b"U1", b"acme-ldo")], [net(b"VOUT", [pin(b"U1", b"3")])], [])


func big_block(subs: env.SubBlock[]) -> env.DesignBlock:
    mut instances = [ic(b"U1", b"acme-mcu")]
    for i in range(1, 13):
        instances.append(cap(("C" + str(i)).encode()))
    instances.append(ic(b"U2", b"acme-io"))
    for j in range(14, 26):
        instances.append(cap(("C" + str(j - 1)).encode()))
    mut vdd = [pin(b"U1", b"1")]
    mut gnd = [pin(b"U2", b"2")]
    for k in range(1, 25):
        mut ref = instances[cap_index(k)].ref_des.copy()
        vdd.append(pin(ref, b"1"))
        gnd.append(pin(ref, b"2"))
    mut result = block(b"Big Board", instances, [net(b"VDD", vdd), net(b"GND", gnd)], [section(b"Core", instances[0:13]), section(b"IO Bank", instances[13:14])])
    result.sub_blocks = subs.copy()
    return result


func big_with_pwr() -> env.DesignBlock:
    return big_block([env.SubBlock(name=b"pwr", block=pwr_block(), source=b"")])


func child_files_of(root: bytes) -> bytes[]:
    mut rest = root.copy()
    mut needle = b"(property \"Sheetfile\" \""
    mut files: bytes[] = []
    while True:
        mut i = rest.find(needle)
        if i < 0:
            return files
        rest = rest[i + len(needle):len(rest)]
        mut end = rest.find(b"\"")
        assert end >= 0
        files.append(rest[0:end])


func zip_central_dir_start(zip: bytes) -> int:
    mut i = len(zip) - 6
    return zip[i] + 256 * zip[i + 1] + 65536 * zip[i + 2] + 16777216 * zip[i + 3]

public func test_ic_package_paste_parsing_empty_and_malformed(out: Stream) -> bool:
    match parser.parse(b"(pad 1 smd rect)"):
        case Err(_):
            return False
        case Ok(ordinary):

# test "cache probe leaves the closure alone without weakening the tamper guard"
public func test_cache_probe_leaves_the_closure_alone_without_weakening_the_tamper_guard(fs: Filesystem, out: Stream) -> bool:
    if not setup(fs, "src") or not write(fs, "src/probe.sexp", b"A"):
        return False
    mut plain = m.read_trace_init()
    m.read_trace_begin(mut plain)
    if not read_trace_file(fs, mut plain, "src/probe.sexp"):
        return False
    m.read_trace_end(mut plain)
    mut plain_digest = m.read_trace_digest(plain)
    mut probed = m.read_trace_init()
    m.read_trace_begin(mut probed)
    mut probe = m.begin_cache_probe(mut probed)
    match m.list_dir_traced(fs, mut probed, "src"):
        case Err(_):
            return False
        case Ok(_):
            pass
    m.cache_probe_end(mut probe, mut probed)
    if not read_trace_file(fs, mut probed, "src/probe.sexp"):
        return False
    m.read_trace_end(mut probed)
    if not ex.eq_bytes(out, "hidden metadata does not change closure", m.read_trace_digest(probed), plain_digest):
        return False
    if not ex.ok(out, "probed verifies", m.read_trace_verify(fs, probed)):
        return False
    mut exposed = m.read_trace_init()
    m.read_trace_begin(mut exposed)
    match m.list_dir_traced(fs, mut exposed, "src"):
        case Err(_):
            return False
        case Ok(_):
            pass
    if not read_trace_file(fs, mut exposed, "src/probe.sexp"):
        return False
    m.read_trace_end(mut exposed)
    if not ex.ok(out, "visible metadata changes closure", m.read_trace_digest(exposed) != plain_digest):
        return False
    mut tampered = m.read_trace_init()
    m.read_trace_begin(mut tampered)
    if not read_trace_file(fs, mut tampered, "src/probe.sexp"):
        return False
    mut probe2 = m.begin_cache_probe(mut tampered)
    match m.list_dir_traced(fs, mut tampered, "src"):
        case Err(_):
            return False
        case Ok(_):
            pass
    m.cache_probe_end(mut probe2, mut tampered)
    m.read_trace_end(mut tampered)
    if not write(fs, "src/probe.sexp", b"B"):
        return False
    return ex.ok(out, "probe never hides consumed bytes", not m.read_trace_verify(fs, tampered))


# test "cache probe rejects an end call away from its owner thread"
public func test_cache_probe_rejects_an_end_call_away_from_its_owner_thread(out: Stream) -> bool:
    # D4: explicit scope ownership instead of a host Thread.Id.
    mut trace = m.read_trace_init()

    if not ex.ok(out, "wrong owner invalidates", not trace.consistent):
        return False
    m.cache_probe_end_with_owner(mut probe, mut trace, True)
    return ex.ok(out, "owner restores scope", trace.active)


# test "read trace rejects symlink removal and retargeting"
public func test_read_trace_rejects_symlink_removal_and_retargeting(fs: Filesystem, out: Stream) -> bool:
    # D4: Filesystem has no symlink creation, target identity, or stat. The
    # supported counterpart covers removal and changed bytes on logical file
    # paths, plus consumed directory membership. Equal-byte symlink retargets
    # cannot be observed and are explicitly outside this adapter's guarantee.
    if not setup(fs, "lib/components") or not setup(fs, "lib/modules"):
        return False
    if not write(fs, "lib/components/alias.sexp", b"same"):
        return False
    mut stable = m.read_trace_init()
    m.read_trace_begin(mut stable)
    if not read_trace_file(fs, mut stable, "lib/components/alias.sexp"):
        return False
    m.read_trace_end(mut stable)
    if not ex.ok(out, "stable logical path", m.read_trace_verify(fs, stable)):
        return False
    match fs.remove("lib/components/alias.sexp"):
        case Err(_):
            return False
        case Ok(_):
            pass
    if not ex.ok(out, "path removal", not m.read_trace_verify(fs, stable)):
        return False
    if not write(fs, "lib/components/alias.sexp", b"changed"):
        return False
    if not ex.ok(out, "observable retarget bytes", not m.read_trace_verify(fs, stable)):
        return False
    if not write(fs, "lib/modules/policy.sexp", b"same"):
        return False
    mut directory = m.read_trace_init()
    m.read_trace_begin(mut directory)
    match m.list_dir_traced(fs, mut directory, "lib/modules"):
        case Err(_):
            return False
        case Ok(_):
            pass
    m.read_trace_end(mut directory)
    if not ex.ok(out, "stable directory", m.read_trace_verify(fs, directory)):
        return False
    match fs.remove("lib/modules/policy.sexp"):
        case Err(_):
            return False
        case Ok(_):
            pass
    return ex.ok(out, "membership removal", not m.read_trace_verify(fs, directory))

    byte_builder.append(mut out, b"\t(lib_symbols\n")
    for s in doc.shapes:
        lib_symbol(mut out, s, Naming.lib_id)
    for r in doc.power.rails:
        rail_symbol(mut out, r, Naming.lib_id)
    if len(doc.power.flags) > 0:

    byte_builder.append(mut out, b"\t)\n")
    if len(doc.sheet.title) > 0:
        caption(mut out, doc.sheet.design, Caption(text=doc.sheet.title.copy(), x=1270, y=1016, size=title_size), b"title")
    for i in range(len(doc.captions)):
        caption(mut out, doc.sheet.design, doc.captions[i], str(i).encode())
    for p in doc.parts:
        placed_symbol(mut out, doc, p)
    for p2 in doc.parts:
        connections(mut out, doc, p2)
    for path in doc.wiring.paths:
        routed_wire(mut out, doc.sheet.design, path)
    for fl in doc.wiring.labels:
        global_label(mut out, fl.net, fl.uuid, fl.side, [fl.x, fl.y])
    for pt in doc.wiring.junctions:

    for rp in doc.power.pins:

public func mm(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, v: int):
    if v < 0:
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b"-")
    mut a = abs(v)
    mut whole = a // 100
    mut frac = a % 100
    if frac == 0:
        byte_builder.append_text(mut w, str(whole))
    elif frac % 10 == 0:
        byte_builder.append_text(mut w, str(whole) + "." + str(frac // 10))
    else:
        byte_builder.append_text(mut w, str(whole) + "." + strs.zero_pad(frac, 2))


public func mm4(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, v: int):
    if v < 0:
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b"-")
    mut a = abs(v)
    mut whole = a // kicad_sym.per_mm
    mut frac = a % kicad_sym.per_mm
    if frac == 0:
        byte_builder.append_text(mut w, str(whole))
        return
    mut digits = 4
    while frac % 10 == 0:
        digits -= 1
        frac = frac // 10
    byte_builder.append_text(mut w, str(whole) + "." + strs.zero_pad(frac, digits))


# Zig helper `str`; suffix avoids hiding the mylang annotation type (G28).
public func str_(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, s: bytes):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\"")
    for c in s:
        if c == 34 or c == 92:
            byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\\")
        _ = byte_builder.append_byte(mut w, c)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\"")


func at(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, x: int, y: int, angle: int):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"(at ")
    mm(mut w, x)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b" ")
    mm(mut w, y)
    byte_builder.append_text(mut w, " " + str(angle) + ")")


func entry_name(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, lib_name: bytes, naming: Naming):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t(symbol \"")
    if naming == Naming.lib_id:
        byte_builder.append(mut w, lib_prefix)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, lib_name + b"\"")


func lib_symbol(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, s: shape_mod.Shape, naming: Naming):
    entry_name(mut w, s.lib_name, naming)
    if s.hide_pin_text:
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\n\t\t\t(pin_numbers (hide yes))\n\t\t\t(pin_names (offset 0) (hide yes))\n")
    else:
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\n\t\t\t(pin_names (offset 0.254))\n")
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t(exclude_from_sim no)\n\t\t\t(in_bom yes)\n\t\t\t(on_board yes)\n")
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t(property \"Reference\" \"U\" (at 0 0 0) " + font_effects + b")\n")
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t(property \"Value\" ")
    str_(mut w, s.lib_name)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b" (at 0 0 0) " + font_effects + b")\n")
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t(property \"Footprint\" \"\" (at 0 0 0) " + hidden_font_effects + b")\n")
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t(property \"Datasheet\" \"\" (at 0 0 0) " + hidden_font_effects + b")\n")
    for u in s.units:
        lib_unit(mut w, s.lib_name, u)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t(embedded_fonts no)\n\t\t)\n")


func lib_unit(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, lib_name: bytes, u: shape_mod.ShapeUnit):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t(symbol \"" + lib_name)
    byte_builder.append_text(mut w, "_" + str(u.number) + "_1\"\n")
    if len(u.graphics) == 0:
        synth_body(mut w, u)
    else:
        for g in u.graphics:
            vendor_body(mut w, g)
    for i in range(len(u.pins)):
        lib_pin(mut w, u.pins[i], pin_text_size(u, i))
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t)\n")


public func pin_text_size(u: shape_mod.ShapeUnit, i: int) -> int:
    mut gap = edge_spacing(u, i)
    if gap is None:
        return 127
    mut fits = (2 * gap // 3) // 10 * 10
    return max(50, min(127, fits))


public func edge_spacing(u: shape_mod.ShapeUnit, i: int) -> int?:
    mut result: int? = None
    for k in range(len(u.pins)):
        mut p = u.pins[k].copy()
        if k == i or p.side != u.pins[i].side:
            continue
        mut d = abs(along_edge(p, p.side) - along_edge(u.pins[i], p.side))
        if d == 0:
            continue
        result = Some(min(result.unwrap_or(d), d))
    return result


func along_edge(p: shape_mod.Pin, side: shape_mod.Side) -> int:
    if side == shape_mod.Side.left or side == shape_mod.Side.right:
        return p.y
    return p.x


func synth_body(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, u: shape_mod.ShapeUnit):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t\t(rectangle (start ")
    mm(mut w, -u.half_w)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b" ")
    mm(mut w, u.half_h)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b") (end ")
    mm(mut w, u.half_w)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b" ")
    mm(mut w, -u.half_h)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b")\n\t\t\t\t\t(stroke (width 0.254) (type default)) (fill (type background)))\n")


func lib_pin(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, p: shape_mod.Pin, size: int):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t\t(pin passive line ")
    at(mut w, p.x, p.y, pin_angle(p.side))
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b" (length ")
    mm(mut w, p.len)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b")\n\t\t\t\t\t(name ")
    str_(mut w, p.name)
    mut name_size = 0
    if p.show_name:
        name_size = size
    pin_text_effects(mut w, name_size)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b")\n\t\t\t\t\t(number ")
    str_(mut w, p.pad)
    pin_text_effects(mut w, size)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b")\n\t\t\t\t)\n")


func pin_text_effects(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, size: int):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b" (effects (font (size ")
    mm(mut w, size)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b" ")
    mm(mut w, size)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b")))")


func vendor_body(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, g: kicad_sym.Graphic):
    if g.kind == kicad_sym.Kind.rectangle:
        named_pts(mut w, g, [b"rectangle", b"start", b"end"])
    elif g.kind == kicad_sym.Kind.arc:
        named_pts(mut w, g, [b"arc", b"start", b"mid", b"end"])
    elif g.kind == kicad_sym.Kind.polyline:
        polyline(mut w, g)
    elif g.kind == kicad_sym.Kind.circle:
        circle(mut w, g)
    else:
        symbol_text(mut w, g)


func named_pts(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, g: kicad_sym.Graphic, spec: bytes[]):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t\t(" + spec[0])
    for i in range(len(g.pts)):
        mut p = g.pts[i]
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b" (" + spec[i + 1] + b" ")
        mm4(mut w, p.x)
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b" ")
        mm4(mut w, p.y)
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b")")
    style_of(mut w, g.style)


func polyline(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, g: kicad_sym.Graphic):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t\t(polyline (pts")
    for p in g.pts:
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b" (xy ")
        mm4(mut w, p.x)
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b" ")
        mm4(mut w, p.y)
        byte_builder.append(mut w, b")")
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b")")
    style_of(mut w, g.style)


func circle(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, g: kicad_sym.Graphic):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t\t(circle (center ")
    mm4(mut w, g.pts[0].x)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b" ")
    mm4(mut w, g.pts[0].y)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b") (radius ")
    mm4(mut w, g.radius)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b")")
    style_of(mut w, g.style)


func symbol_text(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, g: kicad_sym.Graphic):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\t\t\t\t(text ")
    str_(mut w, g.text)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b" ")
    at(mut w, trunc100(g.pts[0].x), trunc100(g.pts[0].y), g.angle % 360)
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b" " + font_effects + b")\n")


func trunc100(n: int) -> int:
    if n < 0:
        return -((-n) // 100)
    return n // 100


func style_of(mut w: byte_builder.Builder, s: kicad_sym.Style):
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b"\n\t\t\t\t\t(stroke (width ")
    mm4(mut w, s.width)
    mut fill_name = b"none"
    if s.fill == kicad_sym.Fill.outline:
        fill_name = b"outline"
    elif s.fill == kicad_sym.Fill.background:
        fill_name = b"background"
    byte_builder.append(mut w, b") (type default)) (fill (type " + fill_name + b")))\n")
